body_markdown:
Welcoming new agents to your contact center is a valuable opportunity to cultivate your brand’s next generation of customer champions. Historically, equipping these agents meant relying on static training manuals, disjointed wikis, and extensive training sessions. Agents had to manually search for information while the customer waited, resulting in slower, inefficient processes. The reality of this broken model is stark. According to Gartner,[61% of customer service leaders](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2024-12-09-gartner-survey-reveals-85-percent-of-customer-service-leaders-will-explore-or-pilot-customer-facing-conversational-genai-in-2025) say they have a backlog of articles to edit, and more than one-third have no formal process for revising outdated articles.


Today, forward-thinking CX leaders are revolutionizing this experience by shifting from static, manual guidance to providing dynamic, AI-powered knowledge in real-time. Recognizing this shift, recent data from[Gartner showed 58% of service leaders](https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-02-18-gartner-survey-finds-ninety-one-percent-of-customer-service-leaders-under-pressure-to-implement-ai-in-2026) aim to upskill agents into knowledge management specialists. By seamlessly integrating company knowledge directly into human-AI collaboration workflows, leaders are setting their teams up for immediate success.


With AI Knowledge in[Five9 Agent Assist](https://www.five9.com/products/agent-assist) , you can modernize how your frontline teams access vital information. Instead of leaving new hires to hunt through static content on their own, AI Knowledge instantly delivers the right answers when they’re needed. To solve the challenge of outdated articles, AI Knowledge features a powerful recommendation engine that automatically extracts FAQs and compares live agent answers against your existing knowledge base to identify content gaps. It then keeps human administrators in the loop to review these insights and decide exactly what to push to the knowledge base, ensuring your resources are always accurate and growing organically.


**Here are three ways leveraging AI Knowledge in Five9 Agent Assist accelerates onboarding and transforms the new hire experience:**


#### 1. How does real-time AI knowledge build agent confidence?


Instead of asking new agents to memorize vast databases,[AI Knowledge](https://www.five9.com/products/capabilities/ai-knowledge) serves as a vital tool to provide company policies, guidance, and next-best actions by harnessing the power of LLMs and the precision of Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) technology. AI Knowledge now includes connectors for third-party systems such as Google Drive and Microsoft OneDrive. With simple configuration in Knowledge Studio, these connectors eliminate the maintenance and overhead of manual file uploads by automatically keeping AI Knowledge in sync with your source-of-truth systems. This integration empowers agents to deliver precise, contextually relevant, and citable answers that are grounded in trusted enterprise data.


#### 2. How does AI agent assist reduce ramp time for new hires?


Bridging the gap between training and live customer interactions is a critical milestone for any new agent. AI Knowledge removes the friction of manual information retrieval, transforming new hires into confident agents right out of the gate. With[GenAI Studio](https://www.five9.com/products/genai-studio) , you can customize how knowledge surfaces to your agents and customers. You can personalize the tone, define the level of granularity and formatting, generate scripts and more. The accelerated learning curve empowers the agent to take ownership of their role and significantly reduces ramp time. In fact, ramp time for new agents on AI-assist tooling dropped from 9.2 weeks to just 5.7 weeks.\[3\] Furthermore, this immediate proficiency translates to the bottom line. According to the[2026 Business Leaders CX Report from Five9](https://www.five9.com/resources/e-book/business-leaders-cx-report) , 89% of organizations using agent assist reporting positive ROI.


####
3. Why does AI-powered onboarding improve agent retention?


When[agents feel confident](https://www.five9.com/blog/5-reasons-why-human-ai-collaboration-your-new-competitive-cx-advantage) and equipped to handle their responsibilities, job satisfaction increases. Real-time guidance powered by a strong knowledge base ensures that agents feel supported, whether they need help with objection handling or simply following specific script adherence. By fostering an environment where agents feel capable and successful early on, organizations can build long-term loyalty and optimize their recruitment investments. In fact, according to the[Five9 2026 Business Decision Makers Report](https://www.five9.com/resources/e-book/business-leaders-cx-report) , 50% of contact center leaders say AI has reduced agent burnout and attrition at their organization. Additionally, 46% of respondents said AI has reduced agent workloads via knowledge retrieval, and 40% said it elevated agents into higher-value work.


By equipping your human workforce with[dynamic, real-time intelligence](https://www.five9.com/resources/datasheet/ai-knowledge?link_norewrite=) , you ensure your agents feel empowered, supported and ready to deliver outstanding CX from their very first interaction.
